summary:
NIYOJAN Phase 6: Complete Frontend Integration & Unified Application Synchronization Report.
Documents the migration of both the Candidate Mobile Application (390×844px) and HR Admin Command Dashboard (1440px) from client-side state to the authoritative Node.js/Express/Firestore backend.
Details the complete component-to-API mapping across all 32 recruitment operations, elimination of localStorage as an authoritative state store, bidirectional state synchronization with polling and window event listeners, cryptographically signed dynamic QR/OTP passes, and comprehensive verification results with 20/20 integration scenarios and 23/23 Vitest tests passing.
